source_contract.inputs: custom reference.get_inputs: int64 position_ids [seq_len], scalar mscale and mscale_all_dim
source_contract.math: YaRN inverse-frequency interpolation; per-row FP8 e4m3 quantize/dequantize; duplicated frequency half; BF16 cos/sin with combined mscale
source_contract.host_device_behavior: run() computes 32 inverse frequencies on host; launcher cudaMallocAsync/cudaMemcpyAsync stages them per call, launches one kernel, and cudaFreeAsyncs on the same stream
source_contract.resource_risk: largest declared sequence 131072 allocates two ~16 MiB BF16 outputs and 32-thread-per-row kernel work; bounded large-row sanitizer is required before capture
